'''Sam's Boombox''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]]. It is obtained by finishing [[Sam]]'s [[Sam#Fourteen Hearts|14-Heart]] event. If interacted with it will play Sam's song from the event. It can be interacted with again to turn it off.

If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}.
